31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Add 2 days → total 219 days.  
03-05-1103 + 219 days:  
1103 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
From 03-05:  
March: 31 − 5 = 26 days remaining.  
April: 30 days → 26 + 30 = 56.  
May: 31 → 87.  
June: 30 → 117.  
July: 31 → 148.  
August: 31 → 179.  
September: 30 → 209.  
Need 219 total, so 219 − 209 = 10 days into October.  
→ October 10, 1103.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1103-10-10
